# ====================

df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2  # df = 32 + 32 - 2 = 62

# Critical value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
# Upper tail: t_crit = t_{1-alpha, df}
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = df)

# For independent t-test with equal n and equal sigma:
# SE(difference) = sigma * sqrt(2/n) = 7.8 * sqrt(2/32)
# ncp = (delta / sigma) * sqrt(n/2) = (delta / SE) is the conventional form
# But more direct: ncp = delta / SE(difference) = delta / (sigma * sqrt(2/n))
#                      = (delta / sigma) * sqrt(n/2)

ncp <- (delta / sigma) * sqrt(n_per_group / 2)

# Power = P(T > t_crit | ncp=ncp, df=df) under H1
power_manual <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp)
